data_label: G0.5 DEVELOPMENT - approximate-real nonland VA sensitivity; not empirical TFP
stock_source_date: December31 of exact source_year; land excluded coherently using four preserved raw components
gross_additions_meaning: Nonland purchase/additions/construction/major repairs during exact source year; gross, no sales deduction
raw_component_policy: Every component must have action=preserve in pinned G0.5 column-policy. Do not mix jittered totals with raw components, infer jitter factors, reconcile totals or fill missing components with zero.

numeric_parser.trim: ASCII space only at either end; tabs and other unsupported characters are not silently stripped
numeric_parser.source_null_export: Adapter null raw strings are preserved as Stata blank strings; source-null counts are separately recorded by preparation.
numeric_parser.transform: Remove commas only after full-string grammar match; decimal point is dot, exponent e/E permitted; no decimal-comma or arbitrary comma stripping.
numeric_parser.finite_bound: abs(value) <= 8.988465674311579e307 (Stata largest nonmissing double); overflow and nonfinite conversion fail.
numeric_parser.component_domain: All four components finite and nonnegative; sum finite. Zero sums retained as measured zero, excluded only from logarithm. Negative components invalidate construction.

transformations.apr_k_end_nominal: sum of the four parsed nonnegative complete stock components
transformations.apr_i_nominal: sum of four parsed nonnegative complete additions components from exact source year
transformations.apr_k_begin: L.apr_k_end_deflated with psid and actual source_year, delta1
transformations.apr_k: log positive finite apr_k_begin; lagged documentary stock-year flag required

units_assumption: Candidate monetary units are used as received, with no invented unit multiplier. Maintain a common positive unit within each monetary family across2010–2012 (annual legacy layouts label000rupiah), without claiming supplier-scale verification. Constant log shifts may be absorbed by intercept/complete polynomial spans; unknown year/firm-varying units, prices, jitter, conditioning and matching dependence are not eliminated.
technology: Separate observed valid five-digit industry_code first-two-digit manufacturing groups10–33. No padding or pooling for N; inter-vintage harmonisation remains provisional.
domain: Pre-lag complete positive production eligibility; history2010 retained. Wrapper intersects exact current and lag eligibility once; dynamic year2012 only. Own OP uses I; LP/ACF/WRDG use materials; common requires both.
selection: One derivative interval ending2012 per synthetic firm observed2011, before production-domain exclusion; official psid matching gives disappearance0 for continuers and1 if unmatched. Endpoint-only rows have no production obs_id/quantities. Fit on available lagged2011 beginning-K and gross-I. Last wave right-censored; no actual closure inferred.
calendar_controls: No additional calendar controls under pinned core; any added year treatment is a separate registered sensitivity.
centering: Use the nominal compatibility branch frozen within-cell logged-variable median translations, preserving full polynomial spans and native-log residual restoration; do not adapt to successful results.
inference_scope: Exploratory full-process synthetic-firm cluster resampling conditional on fictional linkage; no generator uncertainty or population inference. Not999-draw primary acceptance.
limits: Reported VA is single-output-deflated, not double-deflated.
Broad capital-goods basket is coarse for buildings/repairs and does not certify physical capital services.
Output/materials remain coherently jittered current G0.5 values; raw nonland K/I preserve their own common raw convention. No attempt removes perturbations.
Fictional trajectories/disappearance reflect official production-feature matching, not identified economic dynamics or real exit.
Keep all support/rank/convergence failures; no threshold relaxation or extra sectors/years.
Same-version G2 integration remains pending and primary source-unit/price-mapping admission remains false.
